commands.scope: Six independent invocations; core means no feature flag.

policy.step: MisfinServerConfig::timeout: Duration; constructor default30s. Each complete TLS handshake, request read, response write and close-notify gets one allowance, clamped to the fixed whole deadline.
policy.whole: MisfinServerConfig::receive_timeout: Duration; constructor default120s. Epoch starts immediately on successful TCP accept, before spawn. Listener idle time is not charged; pre-poll task queue time is charged. Each accepted connection gets a fresh budget.
policy.invalid: Zero and unrepresentable durations fail as Config errors before TLS configuration/bind. Tests assert exact policy diagnostic with invalid TLS material, without a runtime.
policy.expiry: Private handler returns io::ErrorKind::TimedOut with named step or whole-receive diagnostic; public listener logs connection failure and continues accepting. No byte or phase renews the whole budget, and bytes never renew the request-read step.
policy.dispatch: Check immediately before and after synchronous mailbox dispatch. Do not begin after expiry. A commit already made remains stored after late completion, response failure, close timeout or cancellation. There is no rollback or automatic resend.
policy.framing: Only observed CRLF within2048 wire bytes makes a dispatchable request. Exact fit succeeds; EOF before CRLF and overlong framing do not deliver. Embedded and trailing bare LF are valid message content; remove exactly the final CRLF, preserving message bytes rather than trimming all trailing newlines.
policy.cooperative: Async timers cannot preempt blocking work inside a poll or synchronous storage. Late ready results and late synchronous completion are refused; stored delivery may precede that refusal.

controlled_time_and_carriers: Fixed acceptance epoch shared across individually valid stages; distinct step limit and remaining-whole clamp.
Expired acceptance and late-ready operation cannot run/return success.
Expired receiving and dispatch callback store no mail.
Slow byte arrival cannot renew the complete request-read allowance.
Blocked partial response write and pending shutdown time out while exactly one committed message remains.
Actual synchronous Dispatcher commit plus controlled blocking crosses expiry; callback result refused and single stored message retained.
Exact2048 request accepted; truncated EOF and LF-only EOF rejected59 without mail; embedded/trailing LF preserved.
actual_localhost_tcp_tls: Stalled native TLS handshake reaches its step deadline, handler returns and raw peer observes EOF.
Already-expired acceptance closes native connection before handshake starts.
Completed TLS followed by stalled request reaches read deadline, peer observes connection loss and actual handler mailbox remains empty.
Public configured server:700ms whole beats3s step after800ms idle, for two successive connections, proving policy propagation and fresh accepted budgets.
Existing complete public sending/receiving round trip verifies20, fingerprint META, exact body and claimed sender; existing oversize and trust-status regressions pass.
coverage.limits: Pending close is qualified at the shared private AsyncWrite seam; tokio-rustls shutdown does not wait for peer close-notify. Controlled synchronous blocking is not a claim of physical Redb stall timing. The public listener fixture observes two already-completed peers and the accept-loop result; it does not qualify joining still-running tasks. External mailservers, installed application, product UI, separate machines and radio are unqualified.
